scope: Pinned PAL 8x 65C816 IDE Plus emulator, native 512-byte partitions, 16 KiB loaded COPY, fresh destination, no PRIMES. Source Open through target Close; program loading and driver setup excluded.

raw_driver_baseline.scope: Driver-only sequential sector copy, no filesystem or cache. Setup/teardown excluded; final sector copied with its padding.

profile_observation.limitation: Pinned bridge truncates profile addresses to 16 bits; no reliable exclusive percentages for upper-bank routines are claimed.

findings: Verification removal cuts elapsed time by 23.35% on matched inputs.
Every Ready check returns on its first status read; no timer sleeps or flushes on the cache-free emulated medium.
47 payload reads and 47 payload writes are contiguous. Metadata totals 7 reads and 14 writes.

Driver-only data copy is about one second; full filesystem copy is about three seconds. Filesystem/block-layer overhead is inferred to be substantial; these are not identical workloads because full COPY includes metadata and lifecycle operations.

COPY already uses 16 KiB and two Write requests for this file. Moving to a buffer larger than this file could save one publication sequence (four metadata writes), without reducing single-sector driver transfers.
priorities: Profile sequential filesystem/cache paths with reliable bank-aware or scoped timing before choosing individual routine changes.
Add bounded contiguous range transfers through the block/IDE interfaces to reduce per-sector request, dispatch and map/cache work while preserving metadata publication ordering.
Evaluate short native PIO bursts to amortize board selection while retaining IRQ/NMI safety.
validation: Successful COPY and phase runs independently audit persisted file bytes/allocation; driver-only run compares the entire disk image. Guards, ownership cleanup and OS restoration pass. Development evidence only; volatile-cache hardware speed is not measured.

service_observation.scope: Same emitted build and fresh media; debugger tracing matches gateway counter delta; timing unusable.

assumptions: IDE worker opens only its immutable timer.device request
IORESIDENT callbacks on this worker therefore select timer.device
COP policy switches to the reserved kernel stack; interrupt frames use the 256-byte reserve

consume_baseline.scope: Actual SDFS Consume; root only, resident upper-RAM records/buffers, IRQ/NMI enabled, no disk or other workers. Uninterrupted elapsed instruction time includes machine bus timing; not an ideal CPU-cycle model.
